content.text:
* Folded-cascode input stage and NMOS common-source output
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Low-overdrive reference mirrors
XREF IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XTAIL NT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XBN PB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XBP PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 nf=1 m=1
* NMOS input pair, folded at high-voltage drain nodes
XINN FN VINN NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=4
XINP FP VINP NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=4
XPTN FN PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPTP FP PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XFN ND PB FN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=4
XFP NG PB FP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=4
* Long-channel single-ended current mirror
XND ND ND VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=8 nf=1 m=1
XNO NG ND VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=8 nf=1 m=1
* Output amplifier
XPBIAS VOUT PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XOUT VOUT NG VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=4 nf=1 m=1
RZ NG NC 3000
CC NC VOUT 10p
CBP PB VDD 1p
.ends DUT
